== Trivia ==
* Trying to get too close to any of the [[Auction Agents]] or '''Bromm''' will get the player pushed away. Doing this a few times will teleport the [[player]] outside the {{zone|Dragontail Auction House}}.
*'''Bromm'''<nowiki>'s</nowiki> skin does not load, causing them to render as a Steve skin.
